paragraphs.text: Ergamon is a small, hidden plane with colossal peaks and exotic fauna. The planeswalker Worzel dueled Thomil at least once on this plane. It was also invaded by Phyrexians during the New Phyrexian Invasion . The only known location on Ergamon is the Truga Jungle .

Ergamon is a plane "filled with wild animals" — though no bears — including a race of Rhinos that defended their world during the New Phyrexian Invasion . Curiously, the ecosystem, predator and prey alike, worked in tandem to repel the invaders, an abnormal behavior that suggests some higher power or greater design.
